Working on a Day Off
--------

Is it just my selfish imagination, or is it the truth…?

---------

“Hey, tomorrow’s Saturday, right?”

“Hm, what’s up?”

My wife, who just started her job as a temporary elementary school teacher, began telling me this as soon as she came home.

“The head teacher asked me to help with preparing teaching materials.”

“I see…”

“So, I’ll just go for a bit in the morning, okay?”

“Got it. What time are you going?”

“I need to be there by 8:30, I think.”

“Hmm.”

“…I’m sorry.”

The next morning, when I woke up, my wife had already finished getting ready to leave. She was wearing her favorite outfit that she doesn’t wear to work, probably because she doesn’t have any classes today. It was drizzling outside.

“Ugh, I’m starting to lose motivation to go.”

“Really?”

“Well, but I have to go, right?”

“Hmm.”

Looking reluctant, my wife finished her coffee and stood up.

“I just need to print out the materials for everyone and bind them, so it should be quick.”

“Okay.”

“I’ll be back soon.”

With that, she picked up her usual bag and left.

It’s almost noon now, but…

My wife still hasn’t come back.

Her GPS on her phone shows that she hasn’t moved from her workplace since she left, and she knows I can track her location.

There’s still no response to the message I sent about an hour ago…





The Ring Finger
-
My selfish imagination or the truth…?
-
“Hey? You’re not wearing the ring?”

While having dinner face-to-face, I suddenly noticed that my wife had taken off her ring from her left hand.

“Huh? Oh, yeah. Some kids tend to care about it, so I took it off.”

“Really?”

I was surprised because I had never cared about such things when I was a child.

“Well, they’re not being too showy, but girls tend to care more.”

“I see. Hmm.”

I thought it was just one of those things and didn’t say any more.

“I think you can put the ring back on when we get home, right?”

While soaking in the bath, the thought suddenly came to me and I muttered it.

But by the time I got out, my wife was already fast asleep.

Since then, I couldn’t tell her, and the days went by. The mark on her ring finger was now almost gone.




Chapter Title: Somehow, I Got Scolded
------
Is it just my selfish imagination or is it the truth…?
------
“What’s with the serious face, what are you looking at?”

My wife is sitting in front of her laptop, seemingly lost in thought. I wonder if she’s encountered some kind of trouble, so I take a peek and…

“Oh, she’s asleep.”

Her soft hair carries a gentle scent.

“Ugh, I’d feel bad if I woke her up, but she might catch a cold like this.”

As I debate what to do, I slowly wrap my arms around her delicate shoulders. The simple act of breathing her in feels like it could heal the exhaustion of the entire day.

“Nh? What’s this?”

“Ah, did I wake you up?”

Her groggy, sleepy manner of speaking is so cute that my hand instinctively drifts towards her breasts.

“Hey, it’s hot, you know!”

With a snap, she pushes me away, and my hands desperately search for a destination in mid-air.

“Did you see it?”

“Huh, see what?”

“The laptop screen.”

“No, it was in power-saving mode.”

“I see.”

She closes the laptop lid and stashes it in her bag.

Today, too, my hands are left wandering aimlessly in the air…



Chapter 04: Laundry Basket

“The bath is ready.”

With those words, my wife walks past me. When I look behind, I see her in her pajamas, wiping her hair with a towel, disappearing behind the door.

“Alright.”

I put down my smartphone and head for the bathroom.

“Is it here?”

I gently close the door and search through the basket filled with laundry… and found her underwear right away.

“There doesn’t seem to be anything weird about it…”

Unlike the typical white and sticky fluid that often sticks to the crotch in the stories I saw online, it wasn’t there.

I can’t help but sigh in relief.

Still, the soft fabric in my hands… had enveloped the secret place of the woman I love today. The moment I realized that, my heart pounds intensely again.

I bring my nose closer to it, smelling it very carefully.

A faint scent of urine. And a sweet-sour fragrance that reminds me of a yogurt drink.

If I think that they’re all from her, even these scents are more fragrant than perfume, which is quite strange.

“Yeah, I’m messed up. Seriously.”

Although I would’ve liked to enjoy it a little more, I put it back to its original position. I try to put back the clothes I’ve moved aside when I found it.

“Huh? Did she have something like this?”

As I unfold it, I see a deep blue satin fabric adorned with elegant embroidery and lace. Upon checking the tag, even I recognize the brilliant logo of a famous brand.

She, who values comfort over design, was supposed to only have simple cotton ones…

(Speaking of which, the idea that one should buy and wear tops and bottoms as a set was soon shattered after we got married.)

My body shivers involuntarily as I carefully restore the situation without leaving any traces, and then I enter the bathroom.

“I wish she’d show me what it looks like when she’s wearing it…”

Such a whisper escapes my lips, dissolving into the steam without reaching anyone.

Some time has passed since that day, yet the opportunity to see her wearing it hasn’t arrived.


------
Is it just my imagination or is it the truth?

I still don’t know…
------

Chapter 05 - My Wife’s Breasts

When was the last time I saw her naked? As I look at her back while she sleeps in her pajamas on the bed beside me, I suddenly find myself wondering, and the thought grows bigger.

Seven years since we got married, and I haven’t seen my wife’s naked body, let alone had sex in almost a year.

“Hey, are you awake?” I quietly ask with fear, but there’s no answer.

I hear her gentle snores, so I carefully slip out of the bed. I carefully peek at her face turned toward the wall, and I see her loose hair swinging in sync with her breath on her peaceful sleeping face.

As usual, she’s incredibly adorable, and I have to resist the urge to nibble on her. Instead, I enjoy observing the sleeping figure of my beloved wife.

It would be cruel to wake her up, I tell myself. But I can’t suppress my desires.

Being careful not to creak the bed’s springs, I slowly lean my upper body towards her. Her eyelids occasionally twitch, and the sweet scent that escapes from her slightly parted lips burns away whatever little reason I have left.

Unconsciously, my face moves closer, and I feel her cold touch on the tip of my nose. “… Mm…”

That was close! I listen to her rhythmic breathing.

Maybe it’s because she didn’t wake up, but I can’t help but think of something more daring. Quietly, I climb onto the neighboring bed and wrap my arm around her body from behind.

The scent of shampoo and a faint hint of sweat; the warmth of her body in my arms; my lovely wife.

“… “

In sync with her breathing, my palm feels the rise and fall of her pajama-clad chest.

Once again, I give in to temptation and gently place my hand on its roundness. And I’m introduced to a soft sensation that I’m not familiar with.

To me, her modest B-cup that she’s slightly self-conscious about is a symbol of her delicate beauty.

Shouldn’t I be feeling the hardness of her bra pad? Instead, I feel a soft fullness in my palm that doesn’t match my memory. And there’s a hardness right at the center of my palm…

”…Mm…”

I managed to escape from my wife’s body as she tries to turn in her sleep, but my heart races for another reason.

Staring at my palm, I try to think of what the hard object might have been… “a nipple piercing” is all that comes to mind. But why would my wife have such a thing on her breast?

No, it can’t be. It must be some mistake.

Well, I can’t confirm the truth until I can actually see it.

“Can’t be helped. I should sleep.” I say, but it takes a long time before I finally drift off.
-----
If I notice anything else, I might continue this story.

Chapter 6: A Crimson Mark

I don’t know if it’s just my imagination or if it’s the truth…

“Good morning.”

As I nervously greeted her, she responded with a bright smile and cheerful voice.

Pretending to watch the news on TV, I subtly glanced at my wife who was standing in the kitchen. There was no unnatural shadow on her chest.

“Oh, by the way, I have a meeting tonight, so I think I’ll be home late. …Did any hand, did something happen?”

“Hmm? No, it seemed like it was just my imagination.”

“Really? Ah, about dinner tonight…”

“I got it. I’ll make it.”

“No, that’s not it. I don’t need my share, you can just eat something on your way back from work.”

“Ah, I see. Alright.”

“Sorry, okay?”

“You seem really busy.”

“Well, there’s a lot going on.”

—

“I have to prepare various things, so I’ll be home quite late. Sleep first, okay?”

“Alright. Good luck.”

Even with the lights on, the house somehow felt dark.

“Good morning.”

“Ah, good morning! Sorry about yesterday.”

I peeked at my wife from behind as she tied her hair in front of the dresser. Her carefree smile in the mirror swept away my dark fantasies one by one.

“Don’t push yourself too hard or you’ll get sick.”

“Yeah, thank you. But it’ll be over soon.”

At the edge of my sight, I saw something. A small mark that looked like a red leaf. It was probably not visible to her, hidden in the nape of her neck where her hair was tied up.

“Hey, do we have any ointment for bug bites around here?”

“U-uhm?”

“What’s wrong?”

Her eyes were staring at me through the mirror.

“I’ll look for the bug bite ointment.”

“Thanks!”

I couldn’t bring myself to stare back at her.








07 Cute Dog

My random fantasy or the truth?

“Do you prefer dogs? Or cats?”

My wife asked me this while we were having dinner, just the two of us facing each other for the first time in a while.

“Huh?”

As I looked up from the grilled fish I was struggling with, I saw her completely absorbed in a TV show about animals.

“That kitten is so cute!”

I didn’t find it interesting.

“I like dogs more, but I don’t think I need a pet as long as I have you.”

“Wait, are you treating me like a pet?”

“Not really, but maybe.”

“What’s with that?”

She suddenly burst into laughter.

“Do you want me to wear a collar and crawl on all fours?”

I had no idea where she came up with such a thought. Surprised, I saw her smirk and drop another bombshell.

“Or should I grow a tail for you?”

“Really!?”

Biting into her joke, she stared back at me with glaring eyes.

“…It’s a joke.”

Ugh…

“So, you have that kind of hobby. I didn’t know that.”

“Let’s take a closer look at the mysterious behavior of this curious animal with some rare footage!”

I seriously considered smashing the TV and throwing it out the window.


08 My Wife’s Shower

My random fantasy or the truth?

There was something that bothered me yesterday.

Recently, my wife always takes a shower almost as soon as she comes home.

It’s already October, and it’s not even hot enough to sweat. In fact, wearing short sleeves sometimes feels cool. And she is not just rinsing herself under the water, she properly uses soap, so she doesn’t seem to be planning to take a bath before going to bed.

Well, since she often comes home later than me, as long as she is careful, she wouldn’t catch a cold from cooling down too much after the shower….

“I’m home.”

“Welcome back. Dinner is ready.”

“Thanks. I’ll take a shower first.”

She tossed her belongings on the sofa and quickly disappeared into the bathroom.

“Oh, I forgot to mention…”

I chased after her and knocked on the bathroom door.

“W-what?”

Her reply was a bit flustered. Maybe I startled her.

“I heated the water for the bath today.”

“…Thank you.”

I spoke through the door and tried to walk away, but my legs…stopped.

“Should I take a peek just for a moment?”

I’m curious what kind of underwear she’s wearing today. I can’t help it!

Listening carefully, I could hear the sound of the shower running. She must already be in there.

“…A shower?”

I told her that the bathwater was heated, and she should have noticed it too.

“The reason she doesn’t want to soak in the bath… Oh.”

I see, that’s it.

She’s a bit heavier in the chest area, so maybe she needs to wear more supportive undergarments. It makes sense that she wouldn’t want to soak in the bath then.

Anyway, I no longer have a reason to be here.

I headed to the kitchen to reheat the side dish for my wife.








09 Today’s events

I’m writing this on Saturday night, or should I say, the early hours of Sunday. My head is so confused, and I don’t think I can write a coherent sentence, but maybe writing this will help me organize my thoughts.

“Hey, wake up! Hey!”

Last night, I fell asleep on the sofa and was woken up by my wife.

“Did you write this?”

She held the screen of my smartphone with a twisted smile on her face.

On the screen was a fantasy story that I had written. I couldn’t find the right words to respond, and a few moments passed in silence.

“So it is.”

From that moment, conversation and laughter disappeared from our house.

And then, this morning.

It was Saturday, and my wife was supposed to be off work, but she had a large suitcase with her.

“I’m going on a training trip. I’ll be back tomorrow night.”

“But I thought you said you weren’t going…”

The door slammed shut, hiding her figure from me.

In the afternoon, I received an email from my wife. It had no subject or content, just an attached file.

When I opened it, I found a picture of a couple nestled together with picturesque mountains in the background. My wife, with her hair down and blowing in the wind, smiled happily next to a man I didn’t know.

Later that night, another email arrived. This time, there were two attachments.

The first showed my wife in a seductive pose with a beautifully lit garden in the background. She wore a colorful, floral-patterned lace bra and barely-there panties. A frilly garter belt wrapped around her slim waist with stockings attached halfway up her thighs. Her unfamiliar, enchanting smile pierced my heart like a burning, red-hot steel.

In the second photo, she was in an old, dimly lit room. She straddled someone in disarray on a bed with her hair messed up. She had a worried expression on her face, biting her slightly upturned index finger. It was impossible to see where one person’s skin ended and the other’s began.

The mark of her wedding ring had disappeared entirely.

Of course, I tried to contact her through email, phone calls, and social media. However, I got no response from her, and she didn’t answer her phone.

Her GPS location wasn’t being updated either. That man she was with must’ve turned it off.

I’ve been drinking countless glasses of neat whiskey, but I can’t seem to get drunk.

I don’t know what to do. Can someone please tell me?

Is this all just my fantasy, or is it something more?

My wife hasn’t come home yet…

This morning, I noticed an email when I woke up.

In it, my wife was sitting comfortably on a steamy, cobblestoned open-air bath, her expression shy as her beautiful legs were spread wide. There was no sign of a shadow in the center, and from between the gaping petals, a thick and sticky nectar was dripping.

Not feeling like doing anything, the afternoon came. My smartphone vibrated on the table.

My wife lay on a dentist-like chair, her chest exposed and a rather proud expression on her face. Two silver rings pierced her nipples, shining brightly.

As the living room walls turned orange in the evening, I received another photo.

She was wearing a white veil. Extending her left hand wrapped in satin gloves towards the camera and moist droplets running down her cheeks.

Her white dress was generously exposed at the chest, and her plump breasts and piercingly adorned nipples were presented. They looked like rings.

In the dark room where the sun had completely set, a square of light shone.

All my wife wore now was a deep red collar and a glossy black tail, the same color as her hair. The collar’s color matched the leash that someone’s hand was grasping.

She looked at me with a melting expression, crawling on all fours like a dog. From her half-opened red lips, drool was about to spill. 

When I woke up, my sleeves were sticky and smelly with drool.

“Was I…sleeping?”

I looked around the quiet, dark living room. The light from my forsaken smartphone was blinding.

“I will be back tomorrow night.”

That’s what she said before she left.

The date was about to change.

My wife hasn’t come home yet…

  /**

  private static class Node<E> {

    private Node<E> next;         // reference to the subsequent node in the list

    public Node(E e, Node<E> n) {

     */
    public E getElement() { return element; }

    /**

     * @return the following node
     */
    public Node<E> getNext() { return next; }

    // Modifier methods
    /**
     * Sets the node's next reference to point to Node n.
     * @param n    the node that should follow this one
     */
    public void setNext(Node<E> n) { next = n; }

  private Node<E> head = null;               // head node of the list (or null if empty)

  private Node<E> tail = null;               // last node of the list (or null if empty)

  public int size() { return size; }

  /**

   */
  public boolean isEmpty() { return size == 0; }

   * Returns (but does not remove) the first element of the list
   * @return element at the front of the list (or null if empty)
   */
  public E first() {             // returns (but does not remove) the first element
    if (isEmpty()) return null;
    return head.getElement();
  }

  /**
   * Returns (but does not remove) the last element of the list.
   * @return element at the end of the list (or null if empty)
   */
  public E last() {              // returns (but does not remove) the last element
    if (isEmpty()) return null;
    return tail.getElement();
  }

  // update methods
  /**
   * Adds an element to the front of the list.
   * @param e  the new element to add
   */
  public void addFirst(E e) {                // adds element e to the front of the list
    head = new Node<>(e, head);              // create and link a new node
    if (size == 0)
      tail = head;                           // special case: new node becomes tail also
    size++;
  }

  /**
   * Adds an element to the end of the list.
   * @param e  the new element to add
   */
  public void addLast(E e) {                 // adds element e to the end of the list
    Node<E> newest = new Node<>(e, null);    // node will eventually be the tail
    if (isEmpty())
      head = newest;                         // special case: previously empty list
    else
      tail.setNext(newest);                  // new node after existing tail
    tail = newest;                           // new node becomes the tail
    size++;
  }

    if (isEmpty()) return null;              // nothing to remove

    if (size != other.size) return false;

    SinglyLinkedList<E> other = (SinglyLinkedList<E>) super.clone(); // safe cast
    if (size > 0) {                    // we need independent chain of nodes

Digital Rights Nepal (DRN) is a leading non-profit organization in Nepal that was established in 2020 with a crucial mission: to safeguard digital rights and create a safe and secure digital space for all individuals. With a team consisting of rights advocates, academics, civitech advocates, and campaigners, DRN possesses extensive experience in running and implementing internet freedom and digital rights-related projects in Nepal. The organization maintains a wide public network of major stakeholders, further strengthening its influence and impact.

Objectives and Focus Areas:
DRN is committed to advocating for better policies, conducting research, and providing capacity-building initiatives to promote digital rights in Nepal. The organization's primary focus areas include:

Online Freedom of Expression and Association: DRN works tirelessly to protect and promote online freedom of expression and association, recognizing the importance of these rights for a vibrant and democratic society.
Privacy and Data Protection: DRN advocates for strong privacy measures and data protection policies to safeguard individuals' personal information in the digital realm.
Access to Information: DRN believes in the fundamental right of individuals to access information and actively engages in efforts to ensure unhindered access to information for all .
Internet Governance and Cyber Laws/Policies: DRN actively contributes to the development of internet governance frameworks and cyber laws/policies in Nepal, with the aim of creating an inclusive and fair digital environment.
Mis/Disinformation and Hate Speech: DRN addresses the growing challenges of mis/disinformation and hate speech, advocating for responsible digital practices and countering the spread of harmful content.
Cybersecurity and Child Safety: Recognizing the importance of a secure digital space, DRN promotes cybersecurity measures and raises awareness about potential threats and best practices for protection.

Key Achievements:
Since its inception, DRN has achieved significant milestones in its pursuit of digital rights:

Policy Research and Advocacy: DRN actively engages in policy research, reviewing government bills and policies from a right-based approach. The organization collaborates with parliamentarians and contributes to building a supportive policy environment for digital rights. For instance, DRN has reviewed the Information Technology Bill, E-commerce Bill, Draft National Cybersecurity Policy 2078, 2080, Telecommunication Bill 2023, Social Media Management Directive 2078, Election code of conduct, and 11th Amendment of Broadcasting Regulation and advocated for revisions of these bill and draft policies.

Radio Stations Resilience Survey: DRN recognizes the importance of radio stations in disseminating information and promoting digital rights. Through the Radio Stations Resilience Survey, DRN assesses the digital resilience of radio stations, including their online presence, cybersecurity measures, and capacity to withstand digital threats.
Research on Internet Freedom Situation: DRN has conducted comprehensive research on the state of internet freedom in Nepal, analyzing various aspects such as internet access, censorship, content regulation, and the overall digital environment. This research provides valuable insights for advocacy efforts aimed at protecting and promoting internet freedom in the country.
